mathematical_semantics: an atlas chart is a scoped structural object S=(V,E,chi,gamma,q,epsilon) - typed roles and relations, invariants, boundary/context record, quantity of interest, extraction evidence; domain entities stay in provenance while the transfer layer reasons over roles and relations; explicit non-preservation I- is first-class chart data so an intervention touching a non-preserved property fails closed

transition_semantics: evidential commitment ladder: retrieved source != witnessed target applicability != verified target success; a passing witness licenses eligible experience reuse only (retrieval priority, tool activation, search order) and never mints a scientific claim - authority stays with the target's own verification path
composition of partial charts (GLUE) requires a separate composition witness binding operation order, interfaces and incompatibility checks; component witnesses never prove pipeline coherence

verification_contracts: witness contracts are executable and frozen: obligation-level traces with a deterministic content hash emitted before outcome access, so a confirmatory benchmark can freeze the exact contract; each load-bearing obligation is content-bound to its own evidence rather than inheriting authority from the witness object
